title: Rosalind and the Echo
author: Xanthe Thornbury
blurb: Mirabel Ravensworth, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
